steps.title: Custom Seccomp Syscall Whitelisting Profile
steps.description: Construct a JSON Seccomp profile implementing default-deny `SCMP_ACT_ERRNO` policy and whitelisting only essential runtime syscalls (`read`, `write`, `exit_group`, `futex`).
tasks: Add `syscalls` array explicitly whitelisting `read`, `write`, `epoll_wait`, `nanosleep`, and `exit_group` with `action: "SCMP_ACT_ALLOW"`

verification.command: test -f /home/student/security-hardening/seccomp-profile.json && grep -q 'SCMP_ACT_ERRNO' /home/student/security-hardening/seccomp-profile.json && grep -q 'SCMP_ACT_ALLOW' /home/student/security-hardening/seccomp-profile.json && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Drop Capabilities & ReadOnlyRootFilesystem Manifest
steps.description: Configure a Kubernetes SecurityContext that drops all Linux capabilities (`drop: ["ALL"]`), disables privilege escalation, and enforces a read-only root filesystem.
tasks: Add an `emptyDir` mount for `/tmp` so ephemeral writes succeed without compromising root filesystem immutability

verification.command: test -f /home/student/security-hardening/secure-pod.yaml && grep -q 'readOnlyRootFilesystem: true' /home/student/security-hardening/secure-pod.yaml && grep -q 'drop:' /home/student/security-hardening/secure-pod.yaml && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Falco Runtime Threat Detection Rule Authoring
steps.description: Author custom YAML Falco intrusion detection rules to flag interactive shell spawns and unauthorized `/etc/shadow` reads in real-time.
tasks: Define rule `- rule: Container Shell Execution` with condition `spawned_process and container and proc.name in (sh, bash)`
Define rule `- rule: Read Sensitive Shadow File` with condition `open_read and fd.name = /etc/shadow`

verification.command: test -f /home/student/security-hardening/falco_custom_rules.yaml && grep -q 'Container Shell Execution' /home/student/security-hardening/falco_custom_rules.yaml && grep -q 'Read Sensitive Shadow File' /home/student/security-hardening/falco_custom_rules.yaml && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Automated Security Audit & Benchmark Script
steps.description: Write a bash verification script that audits running processes for non-root execution, checks file permissions on `/etc/passwd`, and logs audit results.
tasks: Verify if any running processes have UID 0; log non-compliant processes to `/home/student/security-hardening/audit_findings.log`

verification.command: test -x /home/student/security-hardening/audit_hardening.sh && /home/student/security-hardening/audit_hardening.sh && test -f /home/student/security-hardening/audit_findings.log && echo PASS || echo FAIL
